in_hebrew.name: Griff
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Griff הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'griff,' meaning 'strong, powerful, or fierce.' In medieval Europe, griffins were mythical creatures with the body, tail, and back legs of a lion; the head and wings of an eagle; and an eagle's talons as its front feet.
